bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_su_t_smhr u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/su_sm/dsfd_su_t_smhr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81su_smhr --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_su_t_smhr --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smc_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smc --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smr_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
